scope: Protected import endpoints only; manual import and generic idempotency behavior remain unchanged.

errors.condition: Missing/invalid operation UUID or required transport part; invalid schema/revision, JSON, source/hash, or malformed/unrepresented non-null participantID. An explicit null participantID is accepted pending resolution, not rejected by this case.

error.message: Protected transcript exceeds the supported limits.

errors.condition: Source exceeds byte/text limits or bounded multipart parser limits.
Missing, invalid or expired verified API user credential.
Existing recording-session admission rejects a newly accepted source; reason_code comes from the existing safe billing reason allowlist. No automatic retry or logout.
Current membership/capability or criteria authorization is absent; GET/PATCH caller is not the uploader. Another uploader POST duplicate uses the separate generic conflict rule.
No current import receipt is available. Preserve the original operation; never replace its key automatically.

error.message: Protected import conflicts with the accepted source.

errors.condition: Scoped key/source already exists with different exact bytes or original assessment binding, or belongs to another uploader.

error.message: Assessment cannot be changed in the current state.

errors.condition: Existing attempt/concurrency boundary rejects the requested pending-assessment change.
Rate/quota limit. Honor a valid Retry-After header when present.
Transient server failure or ambiguous acceptance. Replay exact bytes with the same scoped operation.
Identity/database/queue dependency failure or inactive trusted deployment configuration; no anonymous/default workspace fallback.

clientRules: Classify by HTTP status and known error.code; never parse human message text for retry behavior.
Any unexpected or malformed success/error payload requires bounded reconciliation or visible review; never infer acceptance or analysis success.
Retry only the unchanged immutable source, original assessment fingerprint, operation key and owner/context.
Use a bounded retry policy for network/429/appropriate 5xx; honor valid Retry-After. Exhaustion pauses for visible review.
On GET 404 or any unknown non-retryable 4xx, preserve the operation and pause. Do not mint a replacement operation or upload to another context.
Request IDs are diagnostic correlation only and confer no access. Do not log protected source, personal metadata or credentials.
approvalBasis: Coordinator protocol decisions in the current W2 chat, 2026-10-22; approval is not runtime proof.
remainingRuntimeGates: Reviewed and frozen combined importer/W1 dependency-base SHA
Final W1 authMode/history landing and runtime acceptance
Transactional source/charge/dispatch implementation and isolated database/restart verification
Additional own-history GET contracts remain proposals pending coordinator approval

billing.newAcceptedSource: one existing recording-session import charge, including pending source
billing.identicalPostRetry: read persisted receipt before fresh balance/quota admission; no new charge
billing.transactionInvariant: new source, existing-policy ledger/deduction and recoverable dispatch commit safely together

pendingPrecedence: null participantID -> needsParticipant, including empty criteriaIDs
represented participant + nonempty authorized criteriaIDs -> queued

assessmentResolution.failedAnalysisRetry: separate explicit reanalysis policy requires approval; do not reinterpret identical PATCH as reanalysis
